title: Julienne Carrot Salad
description: Julienne Carrot Salad is a fresh, vibrant Chinese-style salad featuring finely cut carrots, crisp cucumber, red bell pepper, and scallions tossed in a fragrant sesame-soy dressing. Rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, and a touch of sugar create a balanced sweet, tangy, and savory profile, while toasted sesame seeds and peanuts add aroma and crunch.

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Salt – ½ tsp, adjusted to taste
Neutral oil – 1 tbsp (canola or peanut oil)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Vegetables
steps: Julienne the carrots, cucumber, and red bell pepper into thin, uniform matchsticks approximately 2–3 inches long.
Thinly slice the scallions and finely julienne the fresh chili if using.
Place all prepared vegetables in a large mixing bowl.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Blanching the Carrots
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Add the julienned carrots and blanch for 30–45 seconds for slight softness while retaining their crunch.
Immediately transfer the carrots to ice water to stop cooking and preserve their vibrant color.
Drain thoroughly before adding to the salad.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Preparing the Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, light soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar or honey, salt, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Heat the neutral oil in a small pan until shimmering.
Drizzle the hot oil into the dressing while whisking continuously to bloom the aromatics and intensify their fragrance.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Combining the Salad
steps: Add the prepared vegetables to the dressing.
Toss thoroughly until every vegetable is evenly coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional soy sauce, vinegar, or sugar as needed.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Presentation
steps: Arrange the salad neatly on a chilled serving plate.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, fresh cilantro leaves, and crushed roasted peanuts if using.
For a restaurant-style finish, add a few drops of high-quality toasted sesame oil just before serving.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Serving
steps: Serve immediately to preserve the fresh crunch and vibrant color.
Alternatively, chill the salad for 15–20 minutes before serving for a cooler, more refreshing presentation.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled or immediately as a refreshing appetizer or side dish.
Pair with fried rice, noodles, dumplings, or Chinese stir-fried dishes.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and crushed peanuts for additional texture and visual appeal.

chefTips: Use precise, uniform julienne cuts so the vegetables have consistent texture and are evenly coated with dressing.
Balance rice vinegar and sugar carefully to achieve the ideal sweet, tangy, and savory flavor.
Blooming the aromatics with hot neutral oil intensifies the garlic, ginger, and sesame fragrance.
Blanch the carrots briefly rather than fully cooking them to soften the raw bite while preserving their crunch.
Drain all vegetables thoroughly before dressing to prevent the salad from becoming watery.
Keep the salad chilled and serve soon after dressing for the best texture and presentation.
